# Merit Trims — Wenzhou Merit Garment Co., Ltd.

> B2B garment button and trim supplier based in Qiaotou Town, Wenzhou, Zhejiang, China. We supply resin/polyester buttons, metal buttons, snap buttons, jeans buttons and rivets, natural buttons, cord locks, eyelets and buckles to apparel brands, garment factories, uniform makers and trim wholesalers worldwide.

Key facts:
- Company: Wenzhou Merit Garment Co., Ltd. (brand: Merit Trims), established in 2014
- Location: Qiaotou Town, Wenzhou, Zhejiang 325107, China
- Products: resin buttons, polyester buttons, metal shank buttons, zinc-alloy and brass buttons, snap buttons / press studs, jeans tack buttons, rivets, corozo buttons, horn buttons, wood buttons, coconut buttons, cord locks, eyelets, buckles
- Services: OEM/ODM custom buttons, laser-engraved or embossed logos, color matching from Pantone references or physical swatches, and custom sizes
- MOQ: confirmed by product, style, size, color, finish, logo process and stock or custom status
- Lead time: confirmed in the quotation after the sample route, material availability and current capacity are checked
- Buyers served: clothing brands, garment manufacturers, uniform & chefwear factories, denim brands, accessories wholesalers
- Contact: mrtmaggie0010@gmail.com | WhatsApp +86 15869483966
- External company profile: https://meritbutton.en.alibaba.com/company_profile.html

## Main pages
- [Home](https://mrtbuttons.com/): overview of all button categories and services
- [Products](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/): full catalog hub
- [Resin Buttons](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/resin-buttons): custom 2-hole, 4-hole, shank, horn-effect and pearl-effect buttons with specification and quote inputs
- [Metal Buttons](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/metal-buttons): zinc-alloy & brass shank buttons, blazer buttons
- [Snap Buttons](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/snap-buttons): prong snaps, ring snaps and 4-part metal snap buttons
- [Jeans Buttons](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/jeans-buttons): tack buttons for jeans, custom denim caps, nails and rivets
- [Cord Stoppers](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/cord-stoppers): wholesale and bulk single-hole, double-hole, pig-nose and mushroom cord locks
- [Plastic Buckles](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/buckles): side-release buckles, ladder locks, triglides, strap adjusters and hooks with a webbing-fit and RFQ checklist
- [Natural Buttons](https://mrtbuttons.com/products/natural-buttons): corozo, horn, wood, coconut shell
- [Custom Buttons (OEM)](https://mrtbuttons.com/custom-buttons): specification-based logo, material, color, size, finish, packing, tooling and sample development
- [FAQ](https://mrtbuttons.com/faq): MOQ, sampling, shipping, payment answers
- [Contact / Request a Quote](https://mrtbuttons.com/contact)
